title: 第17章 异兽血精提取物第18章 力贯千钧
content_zh:
液压金属柱瞬间泄压，缓缓升起。
他一屁股瘫坐在地，大口喘着粗气，机械左腿冒着浓烈的黑烟，彻底宕机。
同一时间，江岳这边的液压柱也触发了结束指令，轰然升空。
那股碾压一切的重量消失的瞬间，江岳的身躯猛地晃了晃。
他睁开眼，双腿的肌肉因为过度充血而剧烈痉挛，但他没有跪下。
江岳双手撑住膝盖，骨节发白，胸膛不断起伏，硬生生站直了脊梁。
“胜了......”
全场死寂。
废弃机库内，只能听到重金属音乐的余音和老兵义肢漏油的滴答声。
数百名刚才还在疯狂叫嚣的赌徒，此刻鸦雀无声。
所有人看着那个站在血洼中、浑身浴血却站到了最后的新兵，眼中满是无法掩饰的震骇。
连战两场，越级硬抗装配义肢的老兵。
他不仅扛了下来，还生生把老兵的义肢熬到了报废！
“这……这他妈还是人吗？”一名督战队老兵咽了口唾沫，只觉得后背发凉。
高台之上。
屠夫张那只独眼死死盯着江岳。
半晌，他紧绷的机械左臂缓缓松开，发出一声令人发瘆的低笑。
“好硬的骨头。好绝的卸力。”
屠夫张的声音在死寂的机库中回荡。他没有丝毫庄家输钱的愤怒，反而透着一种看待极品杀戮兵器的狂热。
他在数据终端上重重一划。

“老兵弃权。新兵江岳，胜！”
“一赔五。”
屠夫张看向江岳，“你的本金三十点，翻五倍，一百五十点。这局流水够大，出场费顶格给你，二十点。”
“总计一百七十点，打过去了。拿去买点好药，别死在明天的操练上。”
叮。
江岳手腕上的终端发出清脆的入账提示音。
【当前余额：175点。】
江岳没有说半句废话，也没有理会周围那些夹杂着震惊、嫉妒与敬畏的目光。
他抬起沉重如铅的双腿，步履维艰却异常坚定地走下金属底座。
徐博如梦初醒，猛地从护栏外冲了进来，一把扶住摇摇欲坠的江岳。
“赢了……你真的赢了！”徐博声音发颤。
江岳靠在徐博肩上，任由口鼻溢出的鲜血滴落在衣襟上。
那双布满血丝的眼睛里，终于闪过一丝冰冷的快意。
一百七十五点积分。
这笔足以让任何新兵为之疯狂的巨款，终于到手。
走出废弃机库，身后的重金属轰鸣与喧闹被厚重的隔离网隔绝。
刚踏入新兵营区冰冷的金属通道，江岳原本平稳的步伐戛然而止。
肌肉大面积纤维断裂，骨骼微小裂纹扩散。
江岳身躯猛地一晃，直直向前栽倒。
“江岳！”

一旁的徐博眼疾手快，一把架住了他的胳膊。
刚一接触，徐博便发出一声闷哼。
太重了。
content_en:
The hydraulic metal column instantly released pressure and slowly rose.
He collapsed on the ground, breathing heavily. The left leg of the machine was emitting thick black smoke and completely shut down.
At the same time, the hydraulic column on Jiang Yue's side also triggered the end command and boomed into the air.
The moment the overwhelming weight disappeared, Jiang Yue's body shook violently.
He opened his eyes, the muscles in his legs spasming violently with hyperemia, but he didn't kneel.
Jiang Yue held his knees with both hands, his joints turned white, his chest kept rising and falling, and he stood up straight with his spine.
"Victory..."
The whole place was dead silent.
In the abandoned hangar, the only sounds that could be heard were the lingering sound of heavy metal music and the ticking sound of oil leaking from the veterans' prosthetic limbs.
Hundreds of gamblers who had been clamoring crazily just now were silent now.
Everyone looked at the recruit standing in the blood puddle, covered in blood but standing at the end, with unconcealable shock in their eyes.
After two battles in a row, he jumped over the rank and fought against the veterans equipped with prosthetic limbs.
Not only did he carry it, he also survived until the veteran's prosthetic limb was scrapped!
"Is this...is this still a fucking human?" A veteran of the Supervisory Team swallowed and felt a chill on his back.
On the high platform.
Butcher Zhang's one eye stared intently at Jiang Yue.
After a long while, his tight mechanical left arm slowly loosened and let out a horrifying low laugh.
"What a strong bone. What a wonderful force-relieving force."
Butcher Zhang’s voice echoed in the dead silence of the hangar. He didn't have the slightest anger of the banker losing money, but instead showed a kind of enthusiasm for the best killing weapons.
He tapped hard on the data terminal.
"The veteran abstains. The new recruit Jiang Yue wins!"
"One pays five."
Butcher Zhang looked at Jiang Yue, "Your capital is 30 points, doubled five times, 150 points. The turnover in this game is big enough, and I will give you the top appearance fee, 20 points."
"The total is one hundred and seventy points. We've beaten it. Take it and buy some good medicine. Don't die in tomorrow's training."
Ding.
The terminal on Jiang Yue's wrist emits a crisp payment prompt.
[Current balance: 175 points. 】
Jiang Yue didn't say a word of nonsense, nor did he pay attention to the looks around him that were mixed with shock, jealousy and awe.
He lifted his legs, which were as heavy as lead, and stepped off the metal base with difficulty but determination.
Xu Bo suddenly woke up from his dream and rushed in from outside the guardrail, holding on to the crumbling Jiang Yue.
"You won...you really won!" Xu Bo's voice trembled.
Jiang Yue leaned on Xu Bo's shoulder, letting the blood from his mouth and nose drip onto his clothes.
A glimmer of cold joy finally flashed through those bloodshot eyes.
One hundred and seventy-five points.
This huge sum of money, enough to make any recruit crazy, was finally obtained.
Walking out of the abandoned hangar, the roar and noise of heavy metal behind him was blocked by a thick isolation net.
As soon as he stepped into the cold metal passage in the recruit barracks, Jiang Yue's originally steady pace came to an abrupt halt.
Large areas of muscle fibers are broken, and tiny cracks in bones spread.
Jiang Yue's body swayed suddenly and he fell forward.
"Jiang Yue!"
Xu Bo on the side had quick eyes and quick hands and grabbed his arm.
As soon as they made contact, Xu Bo let out a muffled groan.
Too heavy.
